installation_absent.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): No MuMu installation root was found (from the configured folder, the running process, the uninstall registry or vendor enumeration). A failed provider startup discovery adds the configured mumu_root.

installation_ambiguous.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): More than one MuMu installation root was found and none was selected explicitly. A failed provider startup discovery adds the configured mumu_root.

shared_adb_multiple_dll_versions.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): The configured adb is MuMu's shared adb and the installation holds more than one Nemu capture DLL version, so no DLL can be chosen without an explicit one. A failed provider startup discovery adds the configured mumu_root.

configured_adb_identity_unrecognized.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): The configured adb does not identify the selected MuMu installation root, so adb and Nemu capture cannot share one installation identity. A failed provider startup discovery adds the configured mumu_root.

root_mismatch.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): A resolved backend file (adb, capture DLL) belongs to another MuMu installation root than the selected one. A failed provider startup discovery adds the configured mumu_root.

dll_outside_root.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): The configured Nemu capture DLL lies outside the selected MuMu installation root. A failed provider startup discovery adds the configured mumu_root.

dll_version_missing.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): No Nemu capture DLL matches the MuMu version folder (nx_device/<version>) of the adb or the running executable. A failed provider startup discovery adds the configured mumu_root.

version_mismatch.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): The adb or the running MuMu executable and the Nemu capture DLL belong to different MuMu version folders. A failed provider startup discovery adds the configured mumu_root.

candidate_absent.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): The selected MuMu installation holds no candidate file for a backend file (adb, capture DLL, MuMuManager). A failed provider startup discovery adds the configured mumu_root.

candidate_outside_root.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): A backend file candidate resolved outside the selected MuMu installation root. A failed provider startup discovery adds the configured mumu_root.

running_executable_topology_invalid.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): The selected running MuMu executable's path does not identify an installation root. A failed provider startup discovery adds the configured mumu_root.

running_version_missing.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): The selected running MuMu executable's path has no MuMu version folder (nx_device/<version>). A failed provider startup discovery adds the configured mumu_root.

target_identity_unavailable.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): No MuMu instance id can be derived for the target instance from its serial. A failed provider startup discovery adds the configured mumu_root.

target_identity_invalid.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): The target instance's explicit MuMu instance id is invalid. A failed provider startup discovery adds the configured mumu_root.

target_identity_mismatch.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): The instance id the target serial implies and the explicit MuMu instance id differ. A failed provider startup discovery adds the configured mumu_root.

target_process_absent.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): No running MuMu device process matches the target instance. A failed provider startup discovery adds the configured mumu_root.

target_process_ambiguous.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): More than one running MuMu device process matches the target instance. A failed provider startup discovery adds the configured mumu_root.

target_executable_missing.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): The running MuMu device process of the target instance has no executable path. A failed provider startup discovery adds the configured mumu_root.

capture_identity_uncoordinated.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): Nemu capture has no MuMu installation identity coordinated with the target and its adb. A failed provider startup discovery adds the configured mumu_root.

provider_version_below_minimum.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): MuMuManager version is below the Runtime's minimum supported MuMuManager version. A failed provider startup discovery adds the configured mumu_root.

provider_version_unparseable.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): MuMuManager version did not produce a four-part numeric version. A failed provider startup discovery adds the configured mumu_root.

registry_source_unavailable.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): The Windows uninstall registry, a MuMu installation source, cannot be read on this platform. A failed provider startup discovery adds the configured mumu_root.

registry_entry_invalid.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): A MuMuPlayer uninstall registry entry carries no usable install location or an unsupported value type. A failed provider startup discovery adds the configured mumu_root.

scrcpy_server_digest_mismatch.description: #402 RD-3: the scrcpy server the executable carries does not match the SHA-256 pinned in scripts/windows-tools/windows-tool-sources.v1.json, or the build embedded none; the scrcpy capture backend of the instance that opens it does not open, and the server is never pushed to the device. A damaged or incomplete installation. Only that instance's scrcpy capture backend is unavailable; the Runtime goes on (coordinator ruling 10-13, board #403 direction).

scrcpy_server_start_failed.description: #402 RD-3: the scrcpy capture backend could not start: pushing the server, the adb forward, starting the server, connecting to it, its stream header or its first frame failed within the start timeout. The open fails as capture_backend_open_failed. Only that instance's run fails and the recovery ladder handles it; the Runtime goes on (coordinator ruling 10-13, the instance-level rule of board #403).

scrcpy_stream_ended.description: #402 RD-3: the scrcpy video stream stopped: the server exited, the socket closed, a packet was malformed or H.264 decoding failed. No frame is delivered from a stream that ended; the capture fails instead of falling back to another backend. Only that instance's run fails and the recovery ladder handles it; the Runtime goes on (coordinator ruling 10-13, the instance-level rule of board #403).

scrcpy_video_size_mismatch.description: #402 RD-3: the scrcpy stream's video size is not the unscaled size requested (the display, or its centred crop to the size alignment), so its frames would be scaled; the stream is refused instead of downsampled. When it happens at the start, the open fails as capture_backend_open_failed. Only that instance's run fails and the recovery ladder handles it; the Runtime goes on (coordinator ruling 10-13 09:2x: every scrcpy code is instance-level).

capture_frame_stale.description: #398 R1 RD-3i: a stream capture backend received no frame encoded after the capture floor (the completion of the last input, or the frame delivered last) within its fresh wait; the step makes no input.

device_state_unreadable.description: A device-state read of a handset (model-398 section 7.1) failed, or its answer has a shape the parser does not know; device_state_probe names the read. When adb answered, the foreign_adb_error link keeps adb's failure output or the answer that could not be read; when adb could not run or did not finish there is no link. The state is never guessed.
device_state_unreadable.common_causes: The phone left adb (unplugged, offline, unauthorized); the phone vendor prints another dumpsys format than the parser knows.
device_state_unreadable.handling: Check the device link; for an unknown shape, add a neutral sample of the new format to the parser.

device_wake_failed.description: The handset's screen was still not awake after one KEYCODE_WAKEUP and the configured settle time (device_state.wake_settle_ms). The run does not start and no other input is sent.
device_wake_failed.common_causes: The settle time is shorter than the phone needs to turn the screen on; the wake key failed.
device_wake_failed.handling: Raise device_state.wake_settle_ms, or check the phone.

device_keyguard_dismiss_failed.description: A keyguard without a credential still showed on the handset after one wm dismiss-keyguard and the settle time. The run does not start.
device_keyguard_dismiss_failed.common_causes: The phone does not dismiss its keyguard from the shell.
device_keyguard_dismiss_failed.handling: Set device_state.keyguard_insecure to wait, or remove the keyguard on the phone.

device_locked.description: A keyguard waits for a person on the handset: it asks for a credential (PIN, pattern, password or biometric), or it asks for none and device_state.keyguard_insecure is wait. The code covers "locked, and a person is needed", whether because of a secure lock or the wait policy. Nothing is sent; the Runtime never enters a credential.
device_locked.common_causes: The phone locked itself after its screen timeout.
